answer: Proof of unique escrow release schedule turns identity into something scarce. Because releases signed off one by one over eighteen months, the gale of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate releases signed off one by one over eighteen months a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the jade of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the wharf is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
